limitations.text: Report does not disclose research design, datasets or analytic methods behind its trend claims, making it hard to judge evidentiary strength.
Many examples highlighted are current or past Red Antler clients (e.g., PopUp Bagels, Elm Biosciences), introducing promotional / selection bias and limiting objectivity.
Narratives and case studies are almost exclusively U.S.–centric (e.g., Times Square, Washington Monument activations), so insights may not generalize to other cultural or regulatory contexts.
Findings are time-bound to the 2026 outlook; rapid shifts in technology, regulation or consumer sentiment could quickly render recommendations obsolete.
Several arguments adopt binary framings (e.g., brands are either “all-in on AI or not”), which may oversimplify nuanced strategic choices and ignore middle-ground approaches.
